full_text: Hello. Hello. Kaise ho? Main badhiya, aap bataiye. Main bhi achhi hoon. Kahan se bol rahe ho? Main Madhya Pradesh se. Haan? Madhya Pradesh. Kya karte ho? Main padhai karta hoon. WhatsApp mein aaoge? Video call chahiye?
